WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctrl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, params
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, cs.open_date, cs.close_date,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, ss.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS diff, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS per_day
FROM store_sales ss
FULL JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
LEFT JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = COALESCE(ss.store_id, td.store_id) AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctrl c ON c.store_id = cs.store_id
ORDER BY rank

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, f.sale_ts_utc
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
), dup AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) ids FROM l GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l) AS lines, (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM l) AS net,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dup WHERE n>1) AS dup_keys, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM l GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM l WHERE etl_loaded_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01') AS late_loaded_net,
 (SELECT MIN(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) AS min_load, (SELECT MAX(etl_loaded_at) FROM l) AS max_load,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM l) AS n_loads

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.sales_line_id) rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no) n
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
)
SELECT sale_date, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(CASE WHEN n>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_dup, SUM(CASE WHEN rn>1 THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS extra_net,
       MIN(CASE WHEN rn>1 THEN etl_loaded_at END) AS extra_load, MIN(CASE WHEN rn=1 AND n>1 THEN etl_loaded_at END) AS orig_load,
       (SELECT net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id=116 AND r.business_date=l.sale_date) AS ctrl_net_sales,
       SUM(net_amount) AS fact_net
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY etl_loaded_at, sales_line_id) = 1
),
returns_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_return_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sales_line_id, return_date, quantity_returned, refund_net ORDER BY return_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM returns_dedup r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctrl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, params
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ROUND(ss.net_sales,2) AS net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 2) AS per_day,
       ss.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS diff,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns_dedup) AS returns_removed
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctrl c ON c.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank
